SF013 uses first8s,0.04V software-calibrated input peak,1s silence and the same
native processor for healthy and R_B1-drift. Same input/Level; raw jackVolts/4
and separate RMS-matched files have explicit gains (not LUFS). Software voltage
units are not physical pickup/codec calibration. Native reduced fixed-V_BE classAB
is not a measured commercial amplifier. Founder listening approval pending.
